How long does it normally take to ship and send a tracking number?
Orders are typically processed within 1 to 2 business days (Monday through Friday, excluding weekends). Once your package ships, you will receive an email with your tracking number. Please allow up to 24 hours after receiving the email for the tracking updates to appear.

Once it ships, how long is delivery?
Delivery times depend on the shipping method selected at checkout. Standard/First Class shipping generally takes 3 to 7 business days, Priority Mail takes about 3 to 4 business days, Express shipping takes 2 to 3 business days, and Overnight shipping arrives in 1 to 2 business days. Please note that weekends do not count toward business days.
